name: 76120 · Fort Worth, TX
findings: ZIP 76120 (Fort Worth) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76120 (Fort Worth) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76120 (Fort Worth) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
